title: Beat Pinball
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small single-pass 180-second stereo master; a continuous 128-second excerpt from 32s forms the station mix and its first 64 seconds form the game mix; -6 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Create one ORIGINAL 180-second stereo DRUM AND BASS instrumental at fixed 172 BPM in 4/4. Imagine the recording starts already in the middle of a loud, fully arranged dance chorus: from beat one through the last, keep a punchy two-step kick and snare, clear shuffled hats, rounded rolling bass, full bright chords and a short pitched lead attack every quarter beat. The hook is a two-note low launch bouncing into four high descending notes, with a changed answer and bass movement after 96 seconds. The 32-to-160-second passage must remain at full, nearly even energy in every eight-second interval, especially the first and final forty seconds. Clean, playful, melodic sound for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game. No intro, breakdown, sparse bridge, filtered buildup, fade, silent tail, vocals, speech, samples, copying or tempo drift.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: one cyan beat sphere ricochets between two angular ivory bumpers leaving coral timing traces, abstract rather than literal arcade machine; no character or text.
